description: This file contains implementations of matrix and vector operations optimized for Metal Performance Shaders (MPS) backend in PyTorch, including dot product, vdot, and addmv functions, with caching and type casting logic.

methods.name: dot_check
methods.description: Validates that tensors are 1D, have the same dtype, size, and device for dot product.

methods.name: dot_mps
methods.description: Computes the dot product of two MPS tensors with caching and type casting.

methods.name: vdot_mps
methods.description: Computes the vector dot product, handling complex types by conjugation.

methods.name: addmv_out_mps_impl
methods.description: Performs the addmv operation (matrix-vector multiplication with addition) optimized for MPS, with caching and type handling.

methods.name: TORCH_IMPL_FUNC(addmv_out_mps)
methods.description: Wrapper function for addmv_out_mps_impl, exposed as a PyTorch implementation.
